deities: The Chaturdasha Devata (fourteen deities): Burasa, Lampra, Bikhatra, Akhatra, Thumnairok, Sangroma, Bonirok, Twima, Songram, Mwtaikotor, Mailuma, Noksumwtai, Swkalmwtai, Khuluma (Kokborok names for Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Durga, Lakshmi, Kartikeya, Saraswati, Ganesha, Samudra, Prithvi, Agni, Ganga, Himadri, Kamadeva); idols are heads only, one silver idol of Shiva, the rest alloy
festivals: Kharchi Puja (Ashadha, July - week-long fair with Snan Yatra in the Howrah river)

history.period: 1761 CE (built by Maharaja Krishna Manikya / Krishna Kishore Manikya; Tripura Tourism also cites 1770 shift from Udaipur)
history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: This temple is NOT in Kailashahar - the CSV town is WRONG. 'Chouddo Devotar Mandir' is the well-documented Chaturdasha (Fourteen Gods) Temple at Khayerpur, Old Agartala, ~6 km from present Agartala, in West Tripura district. Per Tripura Tourism, the fourteen gods were originally at Udaipur in two temples beside the Tripureswar Bhairab Temple; in 1770 Maharaja Krishna Kishore Manikya, defeated by Shamsher Gaze, shifted his capital from Udaipur to Old Agartala and the idols were installed in a new temple (lightuptemples dates the build to 1761 CE by King Krishna Manikya Debbarma). The capital moved to present Agartala in 1840 but the idols remained at Khayerpur. Legend traces the worship of the fourteen gods to Trilochana, a Mahabharata-era contemporary of Yudhishthira, and every Manikya king continued them as royal deities; the idols are unique heads-only figures. The week-long Kharchi Puja in Ashadha (July) draws thousands of devotees, with animal sacrifices an integral feature. Architecture follows the Bengal aatchaala style with Buddhist-influenced dome elements. Documented with the corrected location; do NOT merge with the 14 Deities Temple of Rangauti in Kailashahar (mentioned on the Kailashahar Wikipedia page), which is a separate local shrine.

name: Chouddo Devotar Mandir
town: Khayerpur, Old Agartala (CSV town 'Kailashahar' is WRONG - temple is ~6 km from Agartala, ~160 km from Kailashahar)
town_description: Khayerpur is the old-capital locality of Agartala in West Tripura district, 6 km from present Agartala, where the Manikya kings' palace complex and the Chaturdasha temple stand. Old Agartala hosts the Haveli Museum of living cultural heritage beside the temple and remains the religious heart of Tripura's royal-era institutions.
